name: jackie-chiles-qwen3-17b
reference_text: Who told you to put a bomb on? Let a doctor put a bomb. Who told you to take it? Did I tell you to take it? No. I know the maestro didn't tell you to take it. A power? Who told you to have a power? I didn't tell you to have a power. Who told you to put the cheese on? Did I tell you to put the cheese on? I didn't tell you to put the cheese on.
